MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The smart plug feels like a useful next step because I could add Alexa control to a lamp alongside my existing Fire TV setup.",
    "The Echo Show displays fit my interest in home electronics, and I would choose the Show 8 for its larger screen after checking camera compatibility. The memory card and reader could also support my camcorder if the card format is compatible."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Another Fire TV Stick repeats a function I already have through my existing stick and Fire TV television, so the similarity does not give me a reason to buy it now.",
    "A speaker or lighting starter kit does not meet my current preference for a useful display. Earbuds and five charging cables also lack a clear connection to a need I have expressed.",
    "The wall mount lists a maximum screen size of 42 inches, while my television is 43 inches, and I have no immediate mounting need for my monitor."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Owning Fire TV devices seems to have been taken as interest in almost any Alexa product, although I choose devices for specific uses.",
    "My electronics purchases seem to have been treated as a reason to suggest general accessories, even when there is no clear device or task they would support."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "What I already own matters: a useful addition is more appealing right now than another device that repeats an existing function.",
    "Compatibility and practical fit matter before I choose an accessory, including camera support, memory card format, and supported screen size.",
    "Interest does not always mean I would buy now: I prefer the larger Show 8 over the Show 5, and the storage accessory needs a compatibility check first."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions recognize my interest in connected home and video devices, but miss some distinctions between useful additions, duplicate functions, and accessories that fit my equipment."
}
